decisions.summary: Region paints with PIL primitives and a two-cell margin (GROW = 2.0); regions per consumer window
decisions.why: A calibration of the conservative region round 2 cleared; FR-001/FR-004 unaffected.

decisions.summary: Seat region's static ground on FreeGround's own grid, its taken cells painted exactly; reach as 4-connected components by run-length union-find; envelope tested shrunk by a cell
decisions.why: Implementation and calibration of FR-001's buildable-and-reachable region; the placer still decides every seat.

decisions.summary: Seated homesteads NOT painted into the seat region; region recomputed only per new corridor, not per seated house
decisions.why: FR-001 recomputes the region per change to what stands, naming each seated house. The withdrawal rests on 'painted, Inashiro seated no one', which no research section or measurement records, and the plan attributes that same outcome to the offset-grid over-refusal instead (plan Amendment B1 vs spec Amendment FR-001). Not shown physically impossible (painting neighbors shrunk by the move's reach was not priced) and not measured slower or failing the gate. hamletgen/homesteads/region.py's module docstring still says every seated homestead's box is painted.

decisions.summary: Marsh (and grass) read the KeepoutGrid as one painted region, crescents and ellipse filed in it
decisions.why: FR-004 as written; grass is the GM's own named case.

decisions.summary: static_clear reads the grove region first and, where it reads taken, asks hard/local/lane in turn and returns clear if they all pass; static_clear_many deleted, candidates not read as arrays
decisions.why: FR-004 and US3: each candidate read against the region, not tested against each keep-out in turn. The stated reason (the families say WHICH, drop vs re-seat) covers only stands.py's jittered-grid branch; static_clear's own fallback rescues margin cells in every caller and serves no 'which'. Neither part was built region-only and measured slower or failing the gate, so it is not withdrawn under the plan's rule; nothing makes the literal impossible (a per-family label raster answers 'which'). The grove's calls fell only 1.13x (SC-004 missed).

decisions.summary: Woodland region one per size at 3 px
decisions.why: Calibration measured (8 px moved a parcel off its brook line).

decisions.summary: Field reach and water before any layout; corridor once per seat after the four layouts and the envelope
decisions.why: Narrows FR-002's 'before any layout' for the corridor only. Withdrawn under the plan's rule: asked first it doubled the costliest search (325 vs 166, R10). The GM's own words, 'the lane test done once per seat rather than once per orientation', are still met.

decisions.summary: Per-household layout template withdrawn; template stays keyed on the seat offered
decisions.why: A plan addition no FR requires; withdrawn under the plan's rule (seed 3 seated 9 of 10, R9).

decisions.summary: Keeper as pure verdicts memoized per lane geometry, read by the kept settle, not judged on every write
decisions.why: Follows from D3/D4's withdrawal: with the settle kept, a verdict at every write has no reader. Stated in spec Amendment 1.

decisions.summary: Tree lanes first, repairs at the write (and at the pass boundary), no settle - built and withdrawn; settle rounds stay
decisions.why: Withdrawn under the plan's own rule, both clauses: at the write 21 of 29 specs broken or unreached, one raising, web 15.29 vs 14.30 s; at the pass boundary 10 of 23 refused, 1.38x slower; D2 alone slower (R10, R14). R11 shows the web is in pieces mid-construction by design, so lawfulness at each write needs every construction pass redesigned - an overhaul deferred with measurement, mechanism and sketch. The spec says it is narrower than the GM's lever 3 and that the GM is to be told; that must happen.

decisions.summary: Targeted settle rounds built and withdrawn
decisions.why: Slower on two of three maps and in sum (R12); withdrawn under the plan's rule; the rounds are as before.

decisions.summary: settle_dangling drops a lane its trim cannot mend, as its docstring said
decisions.why: A defect fix (constitution XIV) inside FR-005's area; WebRefused unchanged.

decisions.summary: Comb hem asks every plot's corners at once (hem_rings_to_bank); the single-ring hem scalar
decisions.why: FR-007 as written (12,195 single clearances to 0).

decisions.summary: Mats as a centered fill; page work overlapped with the picture
decisions.why: FR-003, FR-006 as written; unchanged since round 2.
